notes.title: 【Announcement】 Temporary solution for download stuck at 99%
notes.notes:
【Announcement】 Temporary solution for download stuck at 99% 
We have received feedback from some players that they may encounter progress stuck at 99% when downloading the game. After initial troubleshooting, this may be due to a network node issue with the Steam client, not the game itself (our local testing was unable to reproduce the bug, and we have also contacted Steam customer service to assist in the investigation, but have not yet received a response).
You can try the following methods to temporarily solve the problem:

1、Switch the download region

Open Steam → Settings → Download → Download Region → Change to another region (e.g. “East Africa”, etc.) → Restart Steam to continue downloading.

After the download is complete, you can always change back to the original region.

2、Reinstall Steam client

If the above method is ineffective, you can try to uninstall and reinstall the Steam client (please be sure to manually back up the game files before operation, some games may not have the cloud archive function).

(All three of us have tried uninstalling and reinstalling, as well as changing zones and reinstalling ...... but it still can't be reproduced. In the end, it was the group teacher who reinstalled the steam client once and solved the problem ......)

2025/5/7 – Update Log:expanded Si Fangjue's affection side story.
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!

We’ve just pushed a new game update, which mainly includes new romance character dialogues and additional content for Si Fangjue’s affection side story. We've also fixed several bugs that may have affected your gameplay experience~

Due to Steam's update delay, some players may not see the update prompt immediately. If you enter the game without updating, there is a high chance of encountering in-game errors. To avoid affecting your gameplay, we recommend restarting Steam and launching the game again.

Latest Version: 18370894

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44762388/51560158fd86e3dc7ab76e5922e1f4840c3528b5.png[/img]

[h2][b]【New Content】[/b][/h2]
[list]
[*] Added post-affection dialogue for romance characters at the Courtyard.
※ These may trigger randomly when choosing “Chat with them” while interacting with companions in the Courtyard.
[*] Added new reactions from romance and certain bond characters to the player's updated "status".
[*] Added additional side story for Si Fangjue after deepening affection:
The first time you visit the Sect Leader's Office after developing feelings with Si Fangjue, the new storyline will trigger.
[/list]

[h2][b]【Bug Fixes】[/b][/h2]
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue where Jiang Yuanyi’s Personal Route I could not be reviewed in the Exhibition Room.
[*] Fixed facial sprite inconsistencies in Shi Cang’s dialogue on the Undersea Map.
[*] Fixed mismatch between bubble reminders and unlock timing in Zhihan's redemption side quest.
[*] Fixed an issue where feeding cats at the lakeside was possible even if no cats appeared after gifting an extra fish in "Fortune Favors the Bold".
[*] Fixed missing Fresh Meat Mooncake under the Food category in the inventory.
[*] Fixed a bug in the Jinse bad ending where Yan Ge wouldn’t ask the player to leave, preventing progression.
[*] Fixed an issue where quick save retained the last memo note after using the save note function.
[*] Fixed an issue where teasing Ah Hui could indefinitely increase favorability.
[*] Fixed a black screen after returning from vacation.
[*] Fixed an issue where Chang Kongming became non-interactable after triggering a new reaction dialogue.
[/list]

[h2][b]Lastly, here are some helpful reminders about how to trigger the new dialogues and side content:[/b][/h2]

[h3][b]Post-Affection Courtyard Dialogue:[/b][/h3]
Team up with your romance character and visit the Courtyard to trigger this content.
There are two branching versions depending on whether the Courtyard is unoccupied or has multiple residents.

[h3][b]New Status & Companion Reactions:[/b][/h3]
The multiple-resident Courtyard event will cause a certain romance character to become jealous, granting you a new status.
This status lasts for three days and will trigger special NPC reaction dialogues during that time.

[h3][b]Si Fangjue Affection Side Story Trigger Conditions:[/b][/h3]
After developing affection with Si Fangjue, visiting the Sect Leader’s Office for the first time will trigger this story.
It offers further insight into the Sect Leader’s feelings.

[h3][b]Note:[/b][/h3]
[olist]
[*] The requirements for the exclusive ending (loyalty route) are unrelated to the Courtyard.
This update focuses solely on Courtyard-related content, which is why Courtyard residents are involved.
[*] If Zhihan is taken away by another romance route character, future updates will include side stories that may allow them to move into your Courtyard later.
[/olist]

[list]

欺神弄鬼-缇骑大人入职指南——如何赚钱？如何买房？避水珠在哪里？
notes.notes:
各位大人好久不见！

距离大家入职镇武司有一段时间了，我们也根据大人们在社区的提问，整理了欺神弄鬼小Tips。其中包括[b]如何赚钱、避水珠任务、如何查看新手引导教程[/b]等。希望能帮助各位大人，在游戏中获得更好的体验🥰~

[h3][b]💰️来财！如何在欺神弄鬼实现“财富自由”💰️[/b][/h3]
首先登场的，是[b]大人们都非常关心的问题：如何赚钱？[/b]常见的有两个方法：

[b]1、西洲城-五十商会[/b]：
[b]辛夷[/b]会在每周日（上午、下午、傍晚），固定在商会上班，可前往商会找他投资。[b]辛夷在柜台，投资一定会成功[/b]。建议直接投资最高档位！

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44762388/0449e43feae7cfa4d24a2cc7a6f41e6caab7cc56.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44762388/184c54822bb5adde642014643dd262f9701c2c07.png[/img]
※每周仅可进行一次，若有已在进行中的投资项目，则[u][b]无法在同一周内进行二次触发[/b][/u]。

[b]2、钓鱼🎣+摆摊[/b]：
[b]与西洲城码头NPC交谈，获取鱼竿及钓鱼任务🎣[/b]。前往西洲城集市摊位摆摊，[b]部分鱼类等级较高，更易卖出好价钱[/b]。（如文鳐鱼、六眼飞鱼、六角恐龙、萨O班甲鱼、克苏鲁鱼等）

※钓鱼小贴士：想要钓到更高等级的鱼，[u][b]可以在书商处购买并阅读《打窝》，来增强钓鱼技能[/b][/u]。

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44762388/43a6aa479247699703c2de21b6ea6acc93706433.png[/img]

另外我们看到有大人说[b]带掌门更容易钓到文鳐鱼，特此澄清：此为玄学（？）[/b]，[b]掌门对于钓鱼没有任何加成[/b]，大人们不用为了钓鱼邀约掌门。（文鳐鱼属于鱼王，掉落几率相对比其他鱼类低一些，是正常的）

总之无论是您自己钓、邀约攻略对象、找时沧帮忙捉都是没问题的！（但是时沧所捕捉的鱼，并非都是珍贵的鱼。对于他而言，鱼大就是好。[b]他只会捕捉大体型的鱼交给您[/b]。）

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44762388/c33413ae982e05c9a91a559468f37c3dbf254142.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44762388/54955b340402fe18507de78b6d78cbd026fadf35.png[/img]

[h3][url=][b]👋跑图时有什么好玩的事情吗？👋[/b][/url][/h3]
为了不然大人们感到无聊，我们[b]在很多地方都塞了随机事件[/b]，会在跑图时不定期触发。您在事件中或许会收获[b]金钱、经验、道具、物品、属性[/b]等奖励。请尽情探索吧！

部分有时间要求的剧情支线，我们已经将具体时间更新至[b]内置攻略[/b]。您可在：[u][b]【菜单栏】→【图鉴】→【内置攻略】[/b][/u]中查看。

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44762388/3b260e7e241df523873a72632ff6a5b20c3e68bf.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44762388/184bf951e02cf72e19f8f63751f9bae572fda42b.png[/img]

※数值建议优先增加：[u][b]聆听、话术、侦查、智谋、蛊惑[/b][/u]。[b]异语[/b]技能入城后，部分支线剧情有相关需要，可通过与[b]苍穹（小灰哥）、九羲[/b]讨教技艺增加。

[u][b]数值后期均可通过不同方式提升，请大人放心。[/b][/u]

[h3][b][url=]✨️如何增加“你”的经验值？✨️[/url][/b][/h3]
完成[b]主线任务、支线任务[/b]均可大幅增加大人的经验值。
也可以通过在[b]家宅演练武功[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44762388/fc3d1c494a4c74a86a2bb6948637eaaaaf993488.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44762388/258d944e9f7cb99c774cf9a90fa7232ea8312ded.png[/img]

[b]西洲城告示板接任务[/b]、前往[b]乾山观[/b]触发随机事件：[b]偷听道人上课（？）等增加[/b]。

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44762388/a634ded173d307ba36a0a54dbe05150cc814eaa6.png[/img]

[h3][b]🌊避水珠在哪里？🌊[/b][/h3]
避水珠触发条件：[b]在四月与时沧亲密度达到30以上，自动触发[/b]。

任务流程：与时沧亲密度≥30触发→与时沧聊天得知避水珠被拿走→前往【小渔村】触发支线剧情→得到避水珠，前往【浮生海】再次与时沧对话，就可以“下海”啦~

[h3][b]💖任务“爱极恨极”如何触发？🗡️[/b][/h3]
爱极恨极触发条件：[b]一月与司方觉亲密度≥10[/b]，白天前往他的书房自动触发。

任务流程：与司方觉亲密度≥10（需在一月达成）→白天前往他的书房自动触发支线→支线中有部分选择分支，根据您的选择获取对应奖励→[b]5月在卫所处理公务时随机触发[/b]

※选择分支仅用于决定不同奖励，[b]每个选择都有对应奖励[/b]，请按照自己的想法随意选择吧！（后续您也可在[b]衢城云氏商会[/b]，买到未获取的奖励）

[h3][b]🎆宿砚支线如何触发？🎆[/b][/h3]
宿砚支线的判定条件[b]需要连续三天前往坟地[/b]，[b]再回自己的房间触发[/b]。一天上坟三次，是无法触发相应的支线的。

[h3][b]🏠️如何购买外宅？🏠️[/b][/h3]
在二月与西洲城广场的富商对话，她会告诉你目前有一外宅急于抛售。可以与其砍价，最低可2W拿下外宅。若您打算带“知寒”回家（在青云村奴隶商人处），需在2个月内买下知寒，买下后他会自动前往外宅。

[h3][b]🎐跳过的新手引导，如何再次查看？🎐[/b][/h3]
我们在各个环节都放置了新手引导教程，您可在第一次触发相关任务时查看。

我们也在家门口右转的【后山山脚】，放置了一个《唠唠叨叨的小妖怪》用于向大家讲解新手引导。首次与它对话，可以获得道具奖励。

您也可选择【要不要跟我走啊？】的选项，将其放入背包，[b]后续可在【物品】→【珍宝】中找到[/b]，随时查看。

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44762388/7681b0f73f4c3e4c5e63a5540d04d3823177310e.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44762388/af2ca31ef6fbd53af6392c8a0c4f5a586ac0e921.png[/img]

[h3][b]🎉如何在一周目体验到不同角色感情线分支？🎉[/b][/h3]
进入游戏后，您可以在【你的房间】→书桌【设置】→选择【修改部分问卷结果】。以获取不同的攻略角色支线结局。

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44762388/7d4105b925c599136b6a96bc86ba3fb5200d1cf1.png[/img]

[h3][b]🚧windows系统断电后，global文件损坏要怎么办🚧[/b][/h3]
我们最近发现，部分大人的windows系统断电后，[b]可能会出现global文件损坏[/b]的情况。这个文件掌管着存档位置，如果损坏就会不显示存档。（但是闪退等等行为，会让这个文件很容易损坏……）

我们建议您可以优先备份一下[b]global文件[/b]，出现类似情况后可以下载并将其拖入源文件【save】文件夹中进行替换。

文件位置：【帮助】→【steam客服】→【我的账户】→【您steam账户的相关数据】→【steam云】→选【欺神弄鬼】显示文件。

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44762388/a04f4dcef77d2e149864481f918e793cc216d6a8.png[/img]

※该文件[b]只会记录您现有的存档位置[/b]，例如您只存了1-20，那只有前二十个有用。如果存满了60个存档位，则没有问题。完全可以备份然后覆盖。若您不知如何操作，也可以加入bug反馈群联系我们，我们来帮忙修复。

ps：如若steam显示云存档不同步，建议不要强行打开，以免云存档被覆盖了。

[h3][b]🥀出现下述情况该如何做？🥀[/b][/h3]
这个是您电脑关于游戏图形的设置或者是显卡有问题。大人可以尝试重装一下显卡驱动。但如果是硬件问题，我们也无能为力。

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44762388/3f16fb9ebca4cf9bd778febefb51241e1944654d.png[/img]

以上就是本次入职指南的全部内容了！如果您在游玩的过程中，遇到任何问题，可以加入BUG反馈群（1028166656）或填写[url=https://docs.qq.com/form/page/DVk9CckpwWkNIWG9H][b]BUG收集表[/b][/url]我们都能看到！

再次感谢大人们对我们小破游的包容与支持，之后我们也会不断收集大人们的问题，并进行解答的！祝您在欺神弄鬼度过一段的快乐时光~

在《欺神弄鬼》的steam页面，您仍旧可以游玩到[b]免费试玩版本（demo）[/b]。

[h3][b]🎈EA版本究竟是指什么？EA版本具体包含哪些内容？[/b][/h3]
EA版本是指在当前游戏[b][u]已经有一定体量的游戏内容下，开启的抢先体验版本[/u][/b]。之所以会以EA版本的模式发售，主要是我们希望能通过抢先体验的形式，获得大人们的反馈。帮助我们优化游戏并逐步完善内容，不至于“闭门造车”。

EA版本将包含[u][b]150W字的游戏内容[/b][/u]，包含[u][b]十个游戏月份和八个主线章节[/b][/u]。目前也开放了[u][b]11位可攻略对象[/b][/u]的入队互动，[u][b]12位可攻略对象[/b][/u]的普通互动，以及[u][b]3位NPC的结局[/b][/u]。

EA版本预计会持续一年左右，期间我们会[u][b]不定期更新主线剧情与新玩法[/b][/u]。EA版本转正时，游戏价格可能会有所提高。已经购买过EA版本的大人们，[u][b]不会出现需要二次付费购买的情况[/b][/u]。

[h3][b]🎈免费体验版与EA版的差别大吗？[/b][/h3]
基础剧情风格是相同的，但是在系统和互动上会有一些优化。[u][b]可攻略对象及互动上会更为丰富[/b][/u]。大家期待的几个功能也都端上来了！

[h3][b]🎈免费体验版的存档会继承到正式版本中吗？[/b][/h3]
由于免费体验版到EA版本的开发过程中的改进较大。很抱歉大人们的[u][b]免费体验存档无法继承到EA版本中[/b][/u]。

[h3][b]🎈其他想跟大人们说的游玩前阅读指南？[/b][/h3]
因本游为小众题材，且带有较为强烈的个人偏好。

notes.title: Answer frequently asked questions about 《Deceiving God and Playing Ghost》
notes.notes:
Hello, everyone players!
Thanks to the adults for their support! We have also collected some common questions based on the current situation. If an adult encounters the same situation, please check it below ~

[b][u]Q1: What should I do when the following situations occur?[/u][/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44762388/3f16fb9ebca4cf9bd778febefb51241e1944654d.png[/img]
A: This is your computer's settings for game graphics or there is a problem with the graphics card. Adults can try to reinstall the graphics driver. But if it's a hardware problem, there's nothing we can do.

[b][u]Q2: How to exit the interface?[/u][/b]
A: You can use the right mouse button and the EsC key on the keyboard to exit the interface.

[b][u]Q3: Why is the Suinkstone branch line not triggered?[/u][/b]
A: The judgment conditions for the Suinkstone branch line take three days to go to the cemetery and then return to your room to trigger. Visiting the grave three times a day cannot trigger the corresponding branch line.

[b][u]Q4: How to trigger a mermaid instance?[/u][/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44762388/e724a3739ed0275fc495ffbccf69e57f65ab3509.png[/img]
A: Mermaid refreshes randomly. There is a one-in-half chance of refreshing at the seaside. The rest of the time is refreshed on the official version of the seabed.

[u][b]Q5: The first chapter is finished! Where is the next game?[/b][/u]
A: Thanks for asking. The demo version only contains the main line of the first chapter.

[b][u]Q6: What should I do if I don't understand the novice operation? How to fish? How to farm? How to roll dice? How to get drunk? How to meet ghosts?[/u][/b]
A: Adults can now check the help interface first. We will update 9 branches on October 27 to explain the basic operations for everyone.

[b][u]Q7: How long will the official version be available?[/u][/b]
A: The official version is expected to be available in March next year. We will definitely work hard to advance the progress.

[u][b]Q8: Will the official version of the game adapt to the controller?[/b][/u]
A: Thank you for your inquiry. The existing construction period may not be enough for us to study the adapter handle, and we should consider it after the EA version.

[u][b]Q9: Will there be mobile version or mac version?[/b][/u]
A: We will now make every effort to develop the PC version. After the PC version is developed, we will consider adapting it to other versions later.

[u][b]Q10: Will the game have dubbing?[/b][/u]
A: Due to cost and various considerations, we have not decided to use dubbing for the time being.

If you have other questions/bug feedback, you can also comment and feedback in the comment area of the announcement/Q group, etc., and we will solve the problems you encounter! Thank you again for your support!

notes.title: Patch update 2024/5/3
notes.notes:
Update Log:
Increased global movement speed for players.
Strength greater than 20 is normal movement speed, strength less than 20 speed becomes one-half, strength 5 movement speed is one-quarter. Horseback riding is not affected.
Zeroing stamina will start reducing blood.
Bath tubs add a stamina return option.
Staying up all night debuff will reduce stamina every hour.
Increase the success rate of fishing.
Increase the probability of foreign merchants buying Swift Pools and decrease the price of Swift Pools.
Players are forbidden to move while in farming mode.
Eliminating Medicine Valley will have a probability of jumping into a stuck tile.
Add a description button to the planting system.
